description: Swap 10000 on A (collect 99, earn 49) and 10000 on B (collect 99, earn 49), then claim 49 on pool A four times. The seeded hook checks each request against lifetime entitlement (49) and ignores prior claims, so all four succeed and pay 196. R2: paid 196 > earned 49. R3: paid 196 > collected 99, so the third and fourth payments are backed by pool B's reserve (shared custody 198 -> 2, below B's untouched 99). A final legitimate claim of 49 on pool B reverts under the seeded hook because custody was drained to 2, demonstrating the cross-pool insolvency cascade; the repaired control pays A 49 once, rejects the three repeats, then honors B's claim, leaving custody 100 with no violation.
